events.title: 忽思慧《饮膳正要》
events.title_en: Hu Sihui's Yinshan zhengyao (Proper Essentials of Food and Drink)
events.summary: 元代饮膳太医忽思慧撰成《饮膳正要》，汇集宫廷食疗方、饮食宜忌与养生法，是现存较早的系统营养与食疗专著。
events.summary_en: Hu Sihui, dietary physician at the Yuan court, completed the Yinshan zhengyao, gathering court food-therapy recipes, dietary rules and regimen advice. It is one of the earliest surviving systematic works on nutrition and diet therapy.

events.title: 危亦林《世医得效方》
events.title_en: Wei Yilin's Shiyi dexiao fang
events.summary: 元代危亦林据家传五世医术编成《世医得效方》，骨伤部分记载悬吊复位法治疗脊柱骨折，并用草乌等药物作全身麻醉。
events.summary_en: Wei Yilin of the Yuan dynasty compiled the Shiyi dexiao fang from five generations of family practice. Its bone-setting section describes suspension reduction for spinal fractures and general anaesthesia with drugs such as aconite.

events.title: 朱丹溪滋阴学派
events.title_en: Zhu Danxi and the yin-nourishing school
events.summary: 朱震亨（丹溪，1281–1358）倡“阳常有余，阴常不足”，开创滋阴派，完成金元四大家格局。
events.summary_en: Zhu Zhenheng (Danxi, 1281–1358) taught that “yang is often in excess and yin is often insufficient.” He founded the yin-nourishing school and completed the pattern of the Four Great Masters of the Jin and Yuan.
works_en: Gezhi Yulun (Further Discourses on Extending Knowledge)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 《敖氏伤寒金镜录》舌诊图
events.title_en: Ao’s Golden Mirror of Cold Damage, with tongue charts
events.summary: 约1341年《敖氏伤寒金镜录》载舌象图谱，推动舌诊可视化与教学。
events.summary_en: About 1341 Ao’s Golden Mirror of Cold Damage included charts of the tongue, which helped make tongue diagnosis visible and teachable.
works_en: Ao's Golden Mirror of Cold Damage
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 滑寿《十四经发挥》
events.title_en: Hua Shou's Shisi jing fahui (Elucidation of the Fourteen Channels)
events.summary: 滑寿把任、督二脉与十二经并称“十四经”，逐经考订循行与腧穴，对后世经络腧穴学影响深远。
events.summary_en: Hua Shou grouped the Ren and Du vessels with the twelve regular channels as the 'fourteen channels', checking each pathway and its points. The book shaped later channel and acupoint studies.

events.title: 巴黎医学院黑死病咨询报告
events.title_en: Paris medical faculty's plague Compendium
events.summary: 黑死病（1347–1351）席卷欧洲之际，巴黎大学医学院应法王之请于1348年发布《瘟疫纲要》，将病因归于1345年3月20日土星、木星、火星在宝瓶座的“三星合”导致空气腐败，代表中世纪学院医学的权威解释。
events.summary_en: In 1348 the Paris medical faculty attributed the Black Death to a triple planetary conjunction in Aquarius on 20 March 1345 that corrupted the air.

events.title: 居伊·德·肖利亚克《大外科学》
events.title_en: Guy de Chauliac, Great Surgery
events.summary: 教皇医师居伊·德·肖利亚克约于1363年完成《大外科学》，综合阿拉伯与拉丁外科，主导晚期中世纪外科实践。
events.summary_en: About 1363 Guy de Chauliac, physician to the pope, completed the Great Surgery. It synthesized Arabic and Latin surgery and dominated late medieval surgical practice.

events.title: 明代以太医院为核心的医政体系
events.title_en: Ming medical administration centered on the Imperial Academy of Medicine
events.summary: 明朝中央集权高度强化，医政管理随之系统化，形成以太医院为中心的体系。太医院总管医疗政令，也负责培养医生，明清两代的太医院制度对后来的官方医学教育和宫廷医疗影响很大。
events.summary_en: Under Ming centralized rule, medical administration became a systematic structure centered on the Imperial Academy of Medicine (Taiyiyuan), which issued medical policy and trained physicians.

events.title: 新安医家入值太医院
events.title_en: Xin'an physicians serving as imperial medical officials
events.summary: 明清时期，徽州新安医学有一批医家进入太医院任职，形成新安御医群体。这个群体对中医学发展有积极影响，是地域医学流派与宫廷医学互动的代表。
events.summary_en: In the Ming and Qing a group of physicians from the Xin'an (Huizhou) tradition served as imperial medical officials, a group that positively influenced the development of Chinese medicine.

events.title: 约翰·阿德恩肛瘘手术
events.title_en: John of Arderne’s operation for anal fistula
events.summary: 英格兰外科医生约翰·阿德恩约14世纪以肛瘘手术闻名，留下详细手术记录，代表中世纪外科专业化。
events.summary_en: The English surgeon John of Arderne, about the 14th century, was famous for operating on anal fistula and left detailed operative records. He represents the professionalization of medieval surgery.

events.title: 拉古萨三十日隔离令（检疫起源）
events.title_en: Ragusa's 30-day trentino (origin of quarantine)
events.summary: 1377年7月27日，拉古萨（今杜布罗夫尼克）大议会通过法令，要求来自疫区者隔离30天方可入城；此后各城市效仿并延长为40天，“quarantine”一词由此而来。
events.summary_en: On 27 July 1377 Ragusa's Great Council imposed a 30-day separation for arrivals from plague areas, later extended elsewhere to 40 days (quarantino).

events.title: 巴塞罗那圣十字医院成立
events.title_en: Hospital de la Santa Creu, Barcelona
events.summary: 1401年，巴塞罗那主教座堂与百人议会协议合并城中数所医院，建立统一的圣十字医院，国王马丁一世出席奠基；其延续为今日的圣十字与圣保罗医院，旧址现存哥特式建筑。
events.summary_en: In 1401 Barcelona's Cathedral and Consell de Cent merged several hospitals into the Hospital de la Santa Creu, ancestor of today's Sant Pau.

events.title: 《普济方》成书
events.title_en: Completion of the Puji Fang
events.summary: 明永乐年间《普济方》成书，卷帙浩繁，是中国古代最大型方书之一。
events.summary_en: The Puji Fang was completed in the Yongle reign of the Ming. It is enormous in bulk and is one of the largest formula books of ancient China.
sources_en: historical notes from Jiangxi University of Chinese Medicine

events.title: 朱橚《救荒本草》
events.title_en: Zhu Su's Jiuhuang bencao (Famine Relief Herbal)
events.summary: 明周定王朱橚组织栽种观察野生植物，收录可供荒年充饥的植物四百余种并附图，开创以救荒为目的的本草著作。
events.summary_en: Zhu Su, Prince Ding of Zhou, had wild plants grown and observed, and recorded more than 400 species that could be eaten in famine years, each with an illustration. It began a line of herbals written for famine relief.

events.title: 《医学汇编》（Fasciculus medicinae）威尼斯刊印
events.title_en: Fasciculus medicinae printed in Venice
events.summary: 托名约翰内斯·德·凯瑟姆（可能为维也纳医学教授汉斯·冯·基希海姆）的医学文集约1400年已流传，1491年由格雷戈里兄弟在威尼斯刊印，配有解剖、验尿等插图，是早期印刷插图医书的代表；美国国家医学图书馆藏有摇篮本。
events.summary_en: The Fasciculus medicinae attributed to Johannes de Ketham, circulating by 1400, was printed in Venice by the de Gregoriis brothers; NLM holds incunable copies.

events.title: 帕拉塞尔苏斯出生
events.title_en: Birth of Paracelsus
events.summary: 帕拉塞尔苏斯1493年出生于瑞士，后以医化学挑战古代权威，象征文艺复兴医学的反叛气质。
events.summary_en: Paracelsus was born in Switzerland in 1493. He later challenged ancient authority with iatrochemistry and came to symbolize the rebellious temper of Renaissance medicine.

events.title: 伦敦皇家内科医师学院特许状
events.title_en: Royal charter of the College of Physicians of London
events.summary: 1518年伦敦内科医师学院获王室特许状，成为英国医师专业自律与资格认定的重要机构。
events.summary_en: In 1518 the College of Physicians of London received a royal charter. It became an important institution for professional self-regulation and qualification of physicians in England.

events.title: 帕拉塞尔苏斯化学医学
events.title_en: Paracelsus and chemical medicine
events.summary: 帕拉塞尔苏斯（1493–1541）公开抵制盖伦与阿维森纳权威，倡导矿物与化学药物，开创医化学传统。
events.summary_en: Paracelsus (1493–1541) publicly rejected the authority of Galen and Avicenna, advocated mineral and chemical drugs, and opened the iatrochemical tradition.

events.title: 维萨里《人体的构造》
events.title_en: Vesalius, De humani corporis fabrica
events.summary: 安德烈亚斯·维萨里1543年出版《人体的构造》，基于亲自解剖纠正盖伦错误，奠定现代人体解剖学。
events.summary_en: In 1543 Andreas Vesalius published De humani corporis fabrica. Based on his own dissections, it corrected errors in Galen and established modern human anatomy.

image.author: user:Rubén Grassi
image.caption: 《人体的构造》第 190 页木刻
image.caption_en: Vesalius' Fabrica contains many detailed drawings of human dissections, some of them in allegorical poses.

events.title: 帕雷革新火器伤处理
events.title_en: Paré reforms the treatment of gunshot wounds
events.summary: 军医安布鲁瓦兹·帕雷弃用沸油处理枪伤，改用温和敷料与结扎止血，其外科著作影响全欧。
events.summary_en: The military surgeon Ambroise Paré abandoned boiling oil for gunshot wounds and turned to gentle dressings and ligature to stop bleeding. His surgical writings influenced all of Europe.

events.title: 弗拉卡斯托罗传染种子说
events.title_en: Fracastoro’s theory of seeds of contagion
events.summary: 吉罗拉莫·弗拉卡斯托罗1546年提出疫病由可传递的“种子”样实体引起，是近代传染理论的重要先声。
events.summary_en: In 1546 Girolamo Fracastoro proposed that epidemics are caused by transmissible seed-like entities. It was an important forerunner of modern contagion theory.

events.title: 塞尔维特描述肺循环
events.title_en: Servetus describes the pulmonary circulation
events.summary: 米格尔·塞尔维特1553年在神学著作中描述血液经肺循环，同年因异端罪名被处死，其生理见解影响有限但具历史意义。
events.summary_en: In 1553 Michael Servetus described the passage of blood through the lungs in a theological work. The same year he was executed for heresy. His physiological insight had limited influence, but it is historically significant.

events.title: 科伦布详述肺循环
events.title_en: Colombo describes the pulmonary circulation in more detail
events.summary: 雷阿尔多·科伦布1559年更详细描述肺循环，为哈维系统理论提供解剖学前提。
events.summary_en: In 1559 Realdo Colombo described the pulmonary circulation in greater detail, providing an anatomical premise for Harvey’s systematic theory.

events.title: 人痘接种术（明代）
events.title_en: Variolation in the Ming
events.summary: 明中后期中国出现人痘接种；有学者考证最早文献可至1522年，隆庆年间（1567–1572）记载较丰。后经阿拉伯、土耳其传入欧洲。
events.summary_en: In the middle and later Ming, variolation appeared in China. Some scholars trace the earliest text to 1522, while records are richer in the Longqing reign (1567–1572). The practice later reached Europe by way of the Arab world and Turkey.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
Zheng Shanfu, study of the 1522 date

events.title: 奥尔塔《印度药物谈》
events.title_en: Garcia de Orta, Colloquies on the Simples and Drugs of India
events.summary: 加西亚·德·奥尔塔1563年在果阿出版印度药物与热带病论著，开创欧洲热带医学文献传统。
events.summary_en: In 1563 Garcia de Orta published in Goa a treatise on Indian drugs and tropical disease, opening a European literature of tropical medicine.

events.title: 李时珍《濒湖脉学》
events.title_en: Li Shizhen, Lakeside Pulse Studies
events.summary: 李时珍1564年著《濒湖脉学》，以歌赋总结27脉，成为脉学入门经典。
events.summary_en: In 1564 Li Shizhen wrote the Binhu Maixue. In verse it sums up 27 pulses and became a standard introduction to pulse study.

image.caption: 李时珍像

events.title: 一体堂宅仁医会
events.title_en: Yititang Zhairen Medical Society
events.summary: 1568年一体堂宅仁医会创办，是明代医师结社交流的早期例证。
events.summary_en: The Yititang Zhairen Medical Society was founded in 1568, an early example of Ming physicians organizing themselves for exchange.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 澳门出现西式医院
events.title_en: A Western-style hospital appears in Macao
events.summary: 1569年前后澳门出现西式医院，标志西医机构进入中国沿海，开启近代中西医相遇的空间。
events.summary_en: Around 1569 a Western-style hospital appeared in Macao. It marks the arrival of Western medical institutions on the Chinese coast and opens a space in which modern Chinese and Western medicine met.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 《奇经八脉考》
events.title_en: An Exposition on the Eight Extraordinary Vessels
events.summary: 李时珍1577年著《奇经八脉考》，系统考订奇经理论，与《濒湖脉学》同为脉系重要著作。
events.summary_en: In 1577 Li Shizhen wrote the Qijing Bamai Kao, a systematic study of the theory of the extraordinary vessels. With the Binhu Maixue it is an important work on the vessel system.
works_en: Qijing Bamai Kao (Exposition of the Eight Extraordinary Vessels)

events.title: 李时珍《本草纲目》刊行
events.title_en: Li Shizhen’s Compendium of Materia Medica is published
events.summary: 李时珍《本草纲目》1578年金陵版刊行，收药1892种，按纲目分类，是药物学与博物学巨著，后入选世界记忆名录。
events.summary_en: The Jinling edition of Li Shizhen’s Bencao Gangmu was published in 1578. It records 1,892 drugs, classified by headings and entries. It is a major work of pharmacy and natural history and was later inscribed on the Memory of the World Register.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.address: 帕多瓦大学博宫（Palazzo del Bo）
events.address_en: Palazzo del Bo, University of Padua
events.title: 帕多瓦永久解剖剧场建成
events.title_en: Permanent anatomical theatre at Padua
events.summary: 1594年帕多瓦大学在法布里修斯主持下建成世界首座永久性解剖剧场，椭圆形阶梯式看台环绕解剖台，供公开人体解剖教学。剧场至今保存于帕多瓦大学博宫（Palazzo del Bo），可参观。
events.summary_en: The world's first permanent anatomical theatre, built in 1594 at the University of Padua under Fabricius, survives today in the Palazzo del Bo.

events.title: 塔利亚科齐《移植修复缺损外科》
events.title_en: Tagliacozzi's De curtorum chirurgia
events.summary: 博洛尼亚外科与解剖学教授塔利亚科齐于1597年出版《De curtorum chirurgia per insitionem》，系统描述以上臂皮瓣延迟转移再造鼻部的方法，被视为整形外科奠基著作，其上臂皮瓣图至今仍为美国整形外科学会标志。
events.summary_en: Bologna professor Gaspare Tagliacozzi published De curtorum chirurgia per insitionem (1597), describing delayed upper-arm flaps for nasal reconstruction; he is regarded as a founder of plastic surgery.

events.title: 莱顿解剖剧场
events.title_en: Leiden Theatrum Anatomicum
events.summary: 荷兰解剖学家彼得·鲍（Pieter Pauw）在莱顿大学建立解剖剧场并开创莱顿解剖学派，剧场兼作珍奇陈列室，是欧洲最早的解剖剧场之一。关于始建年份另有1594年之说。
events.summary_en: Pieter Pauw established the anatomical theatre of Leiden University (1597), one of Europe's first; some sources give 1594 for its opening.

events.title: 张伯伦家族秘传产钳
events.title_en: Chamberlen obstetric forceps
events.summary: 英国张伯伦家族（1560—1728）于17世纪发明产科钳，作为家族秘密保守多代，直至18世纪才公开。产钳是产科学的关键技术进步，适逢佝偻病致骨盆畸形难产增多。
events.summary_en: The Chamberlen family invented obstetric forceps in the 17th century and kept them secret for generations.

events.title: 杨继洲《针灸大成》
events.title_en: Yang Jizhou, Great Compendium of Acupuncture and Moxibustion
events.summary: 杨继洲《针灸大成》约1601年刊行，集明以前针灸大成，影响后世针灸教学与临床。
events.summary_en: Yang Jizhou’s Zhenjiu Dacheng was published about 1601. It gathers the pre-Ming tradition of acupuncture and moxibustion and influenced later teaching and practice.
works_en: Zhenjiu Dacheng (Great Compendium of Acupuncture and Moxibustion)
sources_en: traditional literature on the history of acupuncture

events.title: 王肯堂《证治准绳》
events.title_en: Wang Kentang, Standards for Diagnosis and Treatment
events.summary: 王肯堂1602–1607年刊《证治准绳》，分科详尽，是明末重要临床全书。
events.summary_en: From 1602 to 1607 Wang Kentang published the Zhengzhi Zhunsheng. Divided in detail by specialty, it is an important late-Ming clinical compendium.
works_en: Zhengzhi Zhunsheng (Standards of Diagnosis and Treatment)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 法布里修斯发现静脉瓣
events.title_en: Fabricius discovers the venous valves
events.summary: 吉罗拉莫·法布里齐约1603年观察下肢静脉瓣，证明血液只能向心流动，直接启发哈维。
events.summary_en: In 1603 Hieronymus Fabricius observed the valves of the leg veins and showed that blood can flow only toward the heart, a direct inspiration for Harvey.

events.title: 桑托里奥计量生理学
events.title_en: Santorio and quantitative physiology
events.summary: 桑托里奥·桑托里奥以秤测“无形出汗”等，开创计量实验生理学先河。
events.summary_en: Santorio Santorio used a balance to measure “insensible perspiration” and other quantities, opening the way to quantitative experimental physiology.

events.title: 陈实功《外科正宗》
events.title_en: Chen Shigong, Orthodox Manual of External Medicine
events.summary: 陈实功1617年著《外科正宗》，对外科疮疡诊疗影响深远（常记为晚明刊行）。
events.summary_en: In 1617 Chen Shigong wrote the Waike Zhengzong. It had a lasting influence on the diagnosis and treatment of sores and ulcers in external medicine. It is usually dated to a late-Ming printing.
works_en: Waike Zhengzong (Orthodox Manual of External Medicine)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 张介宾《景岳全书》
events.title_en: Zhang Jiebin, Complete Works of Zhang Jingyue
events.summary: 张介宾1624年成《景岳全书》，倡阳非有余、温补理论，对明清临床影响巨大。
events.summary_en: In 1624 Zhang Jiebin completed the Jingyue Quanshu. He argued that yang is not in excess and developed warm-supplementation theory, with a large influence on Ming-Qing clinical practice.
works_en: Jingyue Quanshu (Complete Works of Zhang Jingyue)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 哈维《心血运动论》
events.title_en: Harvey, De Motu Cordis
events.summary: 威廉·哈维1628年出版《心血运动论》，以定量与实验论证血液循环，彻底改变生理学。
events.summary_en: In 1628 William Harvey published De Motu Cordis. With quantitative and experimental argument he demonstrated the circulation of the blood and thoroughly changed physiology.

events.title: 金鸡纳树皮传入欧洲
events.title_en: Cinchona bark reaches Europe
events.summary: 约1630年秘鲁总督辖区发现金鸡纳树皮可治热病；耶稣会士萨卢姆布里诺约于1631年将其送往欧洲，“耶稣会士树皮”随后用于疟疾治疗，其有效成分奎宁于1820年分离。
events.summary_en: Cinchona bark, found effective against fevers in the Viceroyalty of Peru c.1630, was sent to Europe by Jesuit Agustino Salumbrino c.1631.

events.title: 吴又可《温疫论》
events.title_en: Wu Youke, Treatise on Warm Epidemics
events.summary: 吴有性（又可）1642年著《温疫论》，提出“疠气”自口鼻而入，突破伤寒框架解释瘟疫，是温病学先声。
events.summary_en: In 1642 Wu Youxing (Youke) wrote the Wenyi Lun. He proposed that pestilential qi enters through the mouth and nose, breaking the cold-damage frame as an explanation of epidemics. It is a forerunner of warm-disease studies.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 邓玉函《泰西人身说概》经毕拱辰润定
events.title_en: Johann Schreck's Taixi renshen shuogai edited by Bi Gongchen
events.summary: 耶稣会士邓玉函口授的西方解剖学著作《泰西人身说概》由山东文人毕拱辰整理润色，是最早用汉文系统介绍欧洲人体解剖知识的文献之一。毕拱辰卒于1644年，润定不会晚于明亡。
events.summary_en: Taixi renshen shuogai, a Western anatomical text dictated by the Jesuit Johann Schreck (Deng Yuhan), was edited by the Shandong scholar Bi Gongchen. It is among the earliest Chinese-language accounts of European anatomy; Bi died in 1644.

events.title: 马尔皮基发现毛细血管
events.title_en: Malpighi discovers the capillaries
events.summary: 马尔切洛·马尔皮基约1661年用显微镜观察毛细血管，填补哈维循环理论中动脉与静脉的连接环节。
events.summary_en: About 1661 Marcello Malpighi observed capillaries with a microscope, filling the missing link between arteries and veins in Harvey’s circulation.

events.title: 威利斯《脑解剖》
events.title_en: Willis's Cerebri anatome
events.summary: 牛津医生托马斯·威利斯1664年出版《脑解剖》，系统描述脑与神经（含脑底动脉环“威利斯环”），对此后两个世纪的神经学影响深远。
events.summary_en: Thomas Willis published Cerebri anatome (1664), a text on the brain and nerves deeply influential for two centuries.

events.title: 胡克命名“细胞”
events.title_en: Hooke names the “cell”
events.summary: 罗伯特·胡克1665年在显微镜下观察软木薄片并命名cells，虽未理解其生命意义，却开启显微形态学。
events.summary_en: In 1665 Robert Hooke observed thin slices of cork under a microscope and named cells. He did not yet understand their significance for life, but the observation opened microscopic morphology.

events.title: 洛尔犬间直接输血
events.title_en: Lower's dog-to-dog transfusion
events.summary: 英国医生理查德·洛尔自1665年起进行动物输血实验，首次实现两犬之间的直接输血，为人体输血尝试奠定基础。
events.summary_en: From 1665 Richard Lower performed the first direct blood transfusion between two dogs.

events.title: 德尼斯首例有记录的人体输血
events.title_en: Denys's xenotransfusion
events.summary: 1667年6月15日，路易十四御医让-巴蒂斯特·德尼斯将羊血输入一名少年体内，被视为首例完整记录的人体输血（异种输血）。后续患者死亡引发诉讼，法国随后禁止输血。
events.summary_en: On 15 June 1667 Jean-Baptiste Denys transfused sheep blood into a human; after later deaths the procedure was banned.

events.title: 同仁堂创建
events.title_en: Founding of Tongrentang
events.summary: 1669年同仁堂创立，成为著名中药老字号，象征清代成药商业与品质传统。
events.summary_en: Tongrentang was founded in 1669 and became a famous old firm of Chinese medicine, a symbol of Qing commercial prepared medicines and of a tradition of quality.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 列文虎克观察微生物
events.title_en: Leeuwenhoek observes microorganisms
events.summary: 安东尼·范·列文虎克1670年代用自制显微镜观察“微小动物”，为微生物学提供视觉证据。
events.summary_en: In the 1670s Antonie van Leeuwenhoek used microscopes he had made himself to observe “little animals,” providing visual evidence for microbiology.

events.title: 西德纳姆临床观察医学
events.title_en: Sydenham and clinical observation
events.summary: 托马斯·西德纳姆强调床边观察与疾病自然史，被誉为“英格兰希波克拉底”，影响经验临床医学。
events.summary_en: Thomas Sydenham emphasized bedside observation and the natural history of disease. He was called the “English Hippocrates” and influenced empirical clinical medicine.

events.title: 法国耶稣会士以金鸡纳治愈康熙疟疾
events.title_en: French Jesuits cure the Kangxi Emperor's malaria with cinchona bark
events.summary: 1693年，法国耶稣会士洪若翰、刘应等用金鸡纳树皮治好了康熙帝的疟疾。康熙此前已对欧洲科学和药物感兴趣，此事提高了传教士在清宫中的地位，是中西医药交流的标志性事件。
events.summary_en: In 1693 the French Jesuits Jean de Fontaney and Claude de Visdelou cured the Kangxi Emperor's malaria with cinchona ("Jesuit's bark"). The emperor already took an interest in European science and medicine, and the cure strengthened the Jesuits' standing at court.

events.title: 汪昂《本草备要》
events.title_en: Wang Ang's Bencao beiyao
events.summary: 清初新安医家汪昂著《本草备要》，选取常用药物，简明扼要地讲解药性和功用，是清代流传最广的本草普及读本之一。至今在中国大陆、台湾和日本仍作为古典被广泛阅读。
events.summary_en: Wang Ang's Bencao beiyao (1694) concisely explains common medicinals and became one of the most widely read Qing materia medica primers. It is still read as a classic in China, Taiwan and Japan.

events.title: 拉马齐尼《论手工业者的疾病》
events.title_en: Ramazzini's De morbis artificum
events.summary: 意大利医生拉马齐尼1700年出版《De morbis artificum diatriba》，为首部专论职业病与工作风险预防的著作，涉及数十种行业，被尊为职业医学奠基之作。
events.summary_en: Bernardino Ramazzini's De morbis artificum diatriba (1700) was the first book on occupational diseases.

events.title: 皮拉里尼在欧洲实施人痘接种
events.title_en: Pylarini performs variolation in Europe
events.summary: 1701年雅各莫·皮拉里尼在欧洲施行人痘接种；该术此前已在中国与奥斯曼等地流行，经蒙塔古夫人等传入英国。
events.summary_en: In 1701 Giacomo Pylarini performed variolation in Europe. The practice was already current in China and the Ottoman Empire and reached Britain through Lady Mary Wortley Montagu and others.

events.title: 黄元御与尊经派及其传人
events.title_en: Huang Yuanyu and his disciples
events.summary: 黄元御（1705—1758）是清代名医，尊经派的代表人物，推崇《内经》、仲景之学。研究者根据地方志、档案记录等资料，考察了他门人的生平、行医经历和成就，说明他的学术在后世有一条传承脉络。
events.summary_en: Huang Yuanyu (1705–1758), a representative of the classical school, was a renowned Qing physician. Research using local gazetteers traces the careers of his disciples.

events.title: 布尔哈弗莱顿临床教学
events.title_en: Boerhaave’s clinical teaching at Leiden
events.summary: 赫尔曼·布尔哈弗在莱顿将床边教学与化学、解剖结合，培养全欧医师，代表18世纪初临床医学。
events.summary_en: Herman Boerhaave at Leiden joined bedside teaching to chemistry and anatomy and trained physicians from across Europe. He represents clinical medicine in the early 18th century.

events.title: 巴多明为康熙编译满文解剖学
events.title_en: Dominique Parrenin's Manchu anatomy for the Kangxi Emperor
events.summary: 法国耶稣会士白晋、巴多明先后为康熙讲授欧洲解剖学。巴多明的讲授编成满文解剖图谱，其中包含哈维的血液循环学说，约成于1710至1722年间；他还奉旨撰写满文医书，结合中医理论与西方医学概念，后译为蒙古文。
events.summary_en: Joachim Bouvet and Dominique Parrenin taught European anatomy to the Kangxi Emperor. Parrenin's teaching produced a Manchu anatomical atlas, compiled c. 1710–1722, that included Harvey's circulation of the blood. He also wrote a Manchu medical work combining Chinese and Western concepts, later translated into Mongolian.

events.title: 蒙塔古夫人引入人痘至英国
events.title_en: Lady Mary Wortley Montagu introduces variolation to Britain
events.summary: 玛丽·沃特利·蒙塔古夫人基于奥斯曼观察，约1721年推动人痘接种在英国贵族中试验推广。
events.summary_en: Drawing on Ottoman observation, Lady Mary Wortley Montagu about 1721 promoted trials of variolation among the British aristocracy.

events.title: 程国彭《医学心悟》
events.title_en: Cheng Guopeng, Awakening of the Mind in Medicine
events.summary: 程国彭1732年著《医学心悟》，以八纲与汗吐下和消清温补概括治法，影响临床教学。
events.summary_en: In 1732 Cheng Guopeng wrote the Yixue Xinwu. It sums up methods of treatment with the eight principles and with sweating, vomiting, purging, harmonizing, dispersing, clearing, warming, and supplementing, and it influenced clinical teaching.
works_en: Yixue Xinwu (Awakening of the Mind in Medicine)

events.title: 黑尔斯首次直接测量动脉血压
events.title_en: Hales measures arterial pressure
events.summary: 英国牧师科学家斯蒂芬·黑尔斯在1733年《血液静力学》中记载：将铜管插入马腿动脉连接玻璃管，血柱升至约8英尺3英寸，为首次直接测量动脉血压。
events.summary_en: In Haemastaticks (1733) Stephen Hales recorded the first direct measurement of arterial blood pressure in a horse.

events.title: 艾曼首例成功阑尾切除
events.title_en: Amyand’s early successful appendectomy
events.summary: 克劳迪乌斯·艾曼1736年完成文献记载较早的成功阑尾切除术。
events.summary_en: In 1736 Claudius Amyand completed a successful appendectomy that is among the earlier ones recorded in the literature.

events.title: 《医宗金鉴》刊印
events.title_en: The Golden Mirror of the Medical Tradition is printed
events.summary: 乾隆朝官修《医宗金鉴》1742年刊印，作为太医院教材，规范临床与考核。
events.summary_en: The official Yizong Jinjian of the Qianlong reign was printed in 1742. Used as a textbook of the Imperial Medical Academy, it standardized clinical practice and examinations.
works_en: Yizong Jinjian (Golden Mirror of the Medical Tradition)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 叶天士《温热论》
events.title_en: Ye Tianshi, Treatise on Warm-Heat Diseases
events.summary: 叶桂（天士）温热病经验约1746年整理为《温热论》，创立卫气营血辨证，标志温病学派成熟。
events.summary_en: Ye Gui’s (Tianshi) experience of warm-heat disease was arranged about 1746 as the Wenre Lun. It established four-level pattern differentiation—wei, qi, ying, and blood—and marks the maturity of the warm-disease school.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 林德柑橘防治坏血病试验
events.title_en: Lind’s trial of citrus against scurvy
events.summary: 詹姆斯·林德1747年在舰上进行对照试验，证明柑橘类可防治坏血病，是早期临床对照研究范例。
events.summary_en: In 1747 James Lind ran a controlled trial on a ship and showed that citrus could prevent and treat scurvy. It is an early example of a controlled clinical study.

events.title: 哈勒“应激性”与《生理学纲要》
events.title_en: Haller's irritability and Elementa physiologiae
events.summary: 瑞士学者冯·哈勒基于567次动物实验（亲做190次）证明应激性（收缩性）为肌肉特有，感受性属神经，并编成八卷《人体生理学纲要》（1757—1766），使生理学成为独立实验科学。
events.summary_en: Albrecht von Haller showed by 567 experiments that irritability belongs to muscle and sensibility to nerves; his Elementa physiologiae established physiology.

events.title: 徐大椿批评温补流弊并称针灸为"失传"
events.title_en: Xu Dachun's critiques of warming-tonification and of acupuncture as a "lost tradition"
events.summary: 吴江医家徐大椿（1693—1771）是乾隆朝名医，猛烈抨击赵献可《医贯》一系的温补学说，反映明清之际人们对药物安全性和疗效看法的分歧。1757年他又称针灸已成"失传"之学，研究者视其为后来清廷废止针灸科的先声。
events.summary_en: Xu Dachun (1693–1771) attacked Zhao Xianke's warming-tonification doctrine. In 1757 he called acupuncture a "lost tradition", which scholars see as foreshadowing its later removal from the Imperial Academy.

events.title: 莫尔加尼《疾病的位置与原因》
events.title_en: Morgagni's De sedibus
events.summary: 帕多瓦解剖学教授莫尔加尼1761年出版《论疾病的位置与原因》，以尸检对照临床症状，确立“疾病位于器官”的观念，使病理解剖学成为重要医学学科。
events.summary_en: Morgagni's De sedibus et causis morborum (1761) established the organ concept of disease and pathological anatomy.

events.title: 奥恩布鲁格胸部叩诊法
events.title_en: Auenbrugger's percussion
events.summary: 奥地利医生奥恩布鲁格经七年研究，于1761年出版《新发明》，提出叩击胸壁、依声音判断胸腔内隐匿疾病的叩诊法，成为物理诊断基础。
events.summary_en: After seven years' study Leopold Auenbrugger described chest percussion in Inventum novum (1761).

events.title: 赵学敏《本草纲目拾遗》
events.title_en: Zhao Xuemin, Supplement to the Compendium of Materia Medica
events.summary: 赵学敏1765年著《本草纲目拾遗》，增补《纲目》未收药物与民间药，并有《串雅》记铃医经验。
events.summary_en: In 1765 Zhao Xuemin wrote the Bencao Gangmu Shiyi, adding drugs and folk medicines omitted from the Compendium. His Chuan Ya also records the experience of itinerant folk healers.
works_en: Bencao Gangmu Shiyi (Supplement to the Compendium of Materia Medica)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 贝克证明德文郡绞痛为铅中毒
events.title_en: Baker on Devonshire colic
events.summary: 1767年6月29日乔治·贝克在伦敦皇家内科医师学院宣读论文，指出德文郡流行的绞痛源于苹果酒压榨与储存设备中的铅，是环境流行病学早期范例。
events.summary_en: George Baker (1767) showed Devonshire colic was lead poisoning from cider-making equipment.

events.title: 约翰·亨特实验外科学
events.title_en: John Hunter and experimental surgery
events.summary: 约翰·亨特（1728–1793）以比较解剖与实验推动外科科学化，对动脉瘤等手术与病理学影响深远。
events.summary_en: John Hunter (1728–1793) used comparative anatomy and experiment to make surgery more scientific. His influence on operations such as those for aneurysm, and on pathology, was lasting.

events.title: 普里斯特利发现氧化亚氮
events.title_en: Priestley discovers nitrous oxide
events.summary: 约瑟夫·普里斯特利1774年发现氧化亚氮等气体；后被戴维注意其麻醉潜能。
events.summary_en: In 1774 Joseph Priestley discovered nitrous oxide and other gases. Davy later noticed its anesthetic potential.

events.title: 威廉·亨特《妊娠子宫解剖图谱》
events.title_en: Hunter's Gravid Uterus
events.summary: 苏格兰解剖学家威廉·亨特1774年在伯明翰巴斯克维尔印刷出版《人类妊娠子宫解剖图谱》，以大型铜版图客观呈现妊娠各期解剖，适逢英格兰助产与产科兴起。
events.summary_en: William Hunter's Anatomia uteri humani gravidi (1774) gave an objective anatomical depiction of pregnancy.

events.title: 波特发现扫烟囱工阴囊癌
events.title_en: Pott and chimney sweeps' cancer
events.summary: 1775年伦敦外科医生珀西瓦尔·波特描述幼年从事扫烟囱者的阴囊癌，归因于长期接触烟灰，为首个与职业暴露相关联的癌症，开启化学致癌研究。
events.summary_en: In 1775 Percivall Pott linked scrotal cancer in chimney sweeps to soot—the first occupational cancer.

events.title: 弗兰克《完整医学警察体系》
events.title_en: Frank's Medicinische Polizey
events.summary: 德意志医生约翰·彼得·弗兰克自1779年起出版多卷《完整医学警察体系》，主张国家以法规管理卫生、生育、食品与环境，是“医学警察”概念与近代公共卫生的奠基文献。
events.summary_en: Johann Peter Frank's multi-volume System einer vollständigen medicinischen Polizey (from 1779) founded state public-health policy.

events.title: 威瑟林洋地黄治疗水肿
events.title_en: Withering uses foxglove for dropsy
events.summary: 威廉·威瑟林1785年发表《关于洋地黄的记述》，系统描述洋地黄治疗水肿（心衰相关）的用法与毒性。
events.summary_en: In 1785 William Withering published An Account of the Foxglove, a systematic description of the use and toxicity of digitalis in dropsy related to heart failure.

events.title: 哈尼曼创立顺势疗法
events.title_en: Hahnemann founds homeopathy
events.summary: 塞缪尔·哈尼曼约1790年起反对放血等主流疗法并创立顺势疗法，成为近代另类医学重要流派（疗效争议大）。
events.summary_en: From about 1790 Samuel Hahnemann opposed mainstream treatments such as bloodletting and founded homeopathy. It became an important current of modern alternative medicine. Its efficacy is heavily disputed.

events.title: 皮内尔解除精神病人锁链
events.title_en: Pinel unchains the insane
events.summary: 法国医生皮内尔任巴黎比塞特尔医院主任医师后解除被锁三四十年的病人锁链，1795年又在萨尔佩特里耶尔推行，倡导“道德疗法”，被视为现代精神病学开端（年份有1792/1793之说）。
events.summary_en: Philippe Pinel removed chains from patients at Bicêtre (c.1793) and later Salpêtrière, introducing moral treatment.

events.title: 詹纳牛痘接种
events.title_en: Jenner’s cowpox vaccination
events.summary: 爱德华·詹纳1796年用牛痘接种预防天花，开创安全疫苗接种，为后世消灭天花奠基。
events.summary_en: In 1796 Edward Jenner used cowpox inoculation to prevent smallpox, opening safer vaccination and laying a foundation for the later eradication of smallpox.

image.caption_en:
Edward Jenner. Oil painting.

events.title: 拉雷飞骑救护与战伤外科
events.title_en: Larrey’s flying ambulance and war surgery
events.summary: 拿破仑军医多米尼克·拉雷改进战地救护（飞骑救护车）与截肢时机，推动军事外科学。
events.summary_en: Napoleon’s surgeon Dominique Jean Larrey improved battlefield evacuation with the flying ambulance and the timing of amputation, and he advanced military surgery.

events.title: 吴鞠通《温病条辨》
events.title_en: Wu Jutong, Systematic Differentiation of Warm Diseases
events.summary: 吴瑭（鞠通）1798年著《温病条辨》，创立三焦辨证，与叶天士并称温病学高峰。
events.summary_en: In 1798 Wu Tang (Jutong) wrote the Wenbing Tiaobian. He established triple-burner pattern differentiation and, with Ye Tianshi, marks a high point of warm-disease studies.
works_en: Wenbing Tiaobian (Systematic Differentiation of Warm Diseases)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 俞根初《通俗伤寒论》
events.title_en: Yu Genchu, Popular Treatise on Cold Damage
events.summary: 俞根初约1799年《通俗伤寒论》倡导寒温融合，反映明清伤寒与温病对话。
events.summary_en: About 1799 Yu Genchu’s Tongsu Shanghan Lun advocated joining cold-damage and warm-disease approaches, reflecting the Ming-Qing conversation between the two.
works_en: Tongsu Shanghan Lun (Popular Treatise on Cold Damage)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 戴维指出氧化亚氮麻醉性
events.title_en: Davy notes that nitrous oxide is anesthetic
events.summary: 汉弗莱·戴维1799–1800年记述氧化亚氮可缓解疼痛，为吸入麻醉史提供早期线索。
events.summary_en: In 1799–1800 Humphry Davy recorded that nitrous oxide can relieve pain, an early clue in the history of inhalation anesthesia.

events.title: 塞尔蒂纳纳分离吗啡
events.title_en: Sertürner isolates morphine
events.summary: 弗里德里希·塞尔蒂纳纳约1804年自鸦片分离吗啡，是植物活性成分分离的里程碑，开启生物碱化学。
events.summary_en: About 1804 Friedrich Sertürner isolated morphine from opium. It was a milestone in separating active plant constituents and opened alkaloid chemistry.

events.title: 牛痘法传入广州
events.title_en: Cowpox vaccination reaches Guangzhou
events.summary: 1805年牛痘接种经澳门/广州传入中国，逐渐替代人痘，是免疫史与中西医交流的重要节点。
events.summary_en: In 1805 cowpox vaccination reached China through Macao and Guangzhou and gradually replaced variolation. It is an important point in the history of immunity and of exchange between Chinese and Western medicine.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 雷奈克发明听诊器
events.title_en: Laennec invents the stethoscope
events.summary: 勒内·雷奈克1816年发明听诊器，使心肺体征可客观听诊，革新诊断学。
events.summary_en: In 1816 René Laennec invented the stethoscope, making heart and lung signs objectively audible and transforming diagnosis.

events.title: 帕金森《论震颤麻痹》
events.title_en: Parkinson's An Essay on the Shaking Palsy
events.summary: 1817年英国医生詹姆斯·帕金森出版《论震颤麻痹》，依据街头及门诊观察，细致描述一种进行性、致残的震颤与运动障碍，被视为神经病学经典，后世以其名命名帕金森病。
events.summary_en: In 1817 James Parkinson published a closely observed clinical account of a progressive, disabling tremor disorder, later named Parkinson's disease.
works_en: An Essay on the Shaking Palsy

events.title: 布兰德尔成功人体输血
events.title_en: Blundell’s successful human transfusion
events.summary: 詹姆斯·布兰德尔1818年完成早期成功的人体输血尝试，为输血医学开辟道路（血型发现前风险极高）。
events.summary_en: In 1818 James Blundell completed an early successful attempt at human transfusion, opening a path for transfusion medicine. Before blood groups were known, the risk was extremely high.

events.title: 太医院废止针灸科
events.title_en: Acupuncture and moxibustion abolished at the Imperial Academy of Medicine
events.summary: 道光二年（1822），清廷下令太医院永远停止针灸科。研究者认为，在徐大椿称针灸"失传"之后，这是一项激进但顺理成章的举措。此后针灸退出官方医学教育，但在民间继续流传。
events.summary_en: In 1822 the Qing court abolished acupuncture and moxibustion at the Imperial Academy of Medicine, a "radical, but consequent act" after Xu Dachun's 1757 remark.

events.title: 傅青主妇科传本
events.title_en: The transmitted text of Fu Qingzhu’s gynecology
events.summary: 托名或传自傅山的《傅青主女科》清中后期广泛刊行，对妇科辨证处方影响极大。
events.summary_en: Fu Qingzhu’s Gynecology, attributed to or transmitted from Fu Shan, circulated widely in the middle and later Qing and strongly influenced gynecological pattern differentiation and prescribing.

events.title: 布莱特描述肾病（布莱特病）
events.title_en: Richard Bright describes renal disease (Bright's disease)
events.summary: 1827年英国医生理查德·布莱特出版《医学病例报告》，将水肿、蛋白尿与尸检所见肾脏病变联系起来，奠定临床—病理相关的肾脏病学基础，此类肾炎长期被称为“布莱特病”。
events.summary_en: Bright's Reports of Medical Cases (1827) linked dropsy and albuminous urine with diseased kidneys at autopsy, founding clinical nephrology.

events.title: 王清任《医林改错》
events.title_en: Wang Qingren, Correction of Errors in Medical Works
events.summary: 王清任1830年刊《医林改错》，强调尸体脏器观察并创活血化瘀诸方，对血瘀证研究影响深远。
events.summary_en: In 1830 Wang Qingren published the Yilin Gaicuo. He emphasized observation of organs in corpses and created formulas for invigorating blood and transforming stasis. His influence on the study of blood-stasis patterns was lasting.
works_en: Yilin Gaicuo (Correction of Errors in Medical Works)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 霍奇金描述淋巴结与脾病变
events.title_en: Thomas Hodgkin describes Hodgkin's disease
events.summary: 1832年托马斯·霍奇金发表《论吸收腺与脾的某些病态表现》，描述七例无痛性淋巴结肿大伴脾肿大的患者，后经威尔克斯推崇命名为霍奇金病，即今霍奇金淋巴瘤。
events.summary_en: In 1832 Hodgkin's paper "On some morbid appearances of the absorbent glands and spleen" described seven patients with painless lymphadenopathy; Wilks later named it Hodgkin's disease.
works: On some morbid appearances of the absorbent glands and spleen
works_en: On some morbid appearances of the absorbent glands and spleen

events.title: 伯驾广州眼科医局（博济前身）
events.title_en: Peter Parker’s Ophthalmic Hospital in Guangzhou (forerunner of Boji Hospital)
events.summary: 美国传教士医生伯驾1835年在广州开设眼科医局，后发展为博济医院，是中国近代西医院先驱。
events.summary_en: In 1835 the American missionary physician Peter Parker opened an ophthalmic hospital in Guangzhou. It later developed into Boji Hospital and was a pioneer of modern Western hospitals in China.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 查德威克《卫生状况报告》
events.title_en: Chadwick’s report on sanitary conditions
events.summary: 埃德温·查德威克1842年报告推动英国卫生改革立法，将清洁供水与排污纳入国家责任。
events.summary_en: Edwin Chadwick’s 1842 report pushed sanitary-reform legislation in Britain and brought clean water and sewage into the responsibilities of the state.

events.title: 克劳福德·朗乙醚麻醉手术
events.title_en: Crawford Long operates under ether
events.summary: 克劳福德·朗1842年用乙醚施行无痛手术，但未及时发表；乙醚麻醉的公开示范稍后由莫顿完成。
events.summary_en: In 1842 Crawford Long used ether for painless surgery, but he did not publish in time. The public demonstration of ether anesthesia was given a little later by Morton.

events.title: 雒魏林在上海创办仁济医院
events.title_en: William Lockhart founds Renji Hospital in Shanghai
events.summary: 伦敦会医学传教士雒魏林在上海县城大东门附近租屋开设医馆，这就是上海第一所西式医院，即今天的仁济医院。他还在上海向中国人推广种牛痘，本地医生在种痘推广中也发挥了重要作用。
events.summary_en: William Lockhart of the London Missionary Society opened Shanghai's first Western-style hospital (today's Renji Hospital) and introduced vaccination in Shanghai.

events.title: 莫顿公开乙醚麻醉示范
events.title_en: Morton’s public demonstration of ether anesthesia
events.summary: 1846年10月威廉·莫顿在麻省总医院公开乙醚麻醉手术，全麻迅速传播，外科进入无痛时代。
events.summary_en: In October 1846 William Morton publicly demonstrated surgery under ether at Massachusetts General Hospital. General anesthesia spread quickly, and surgery entered an era without operative pain.

events.title: 塞麦尔维斯洗手防产褥热
events.title_en: Semmelweis and handwashing against puerperal fever
events.summary: 伊格纳茨·塞麦尔维斯1847年发现医师洗手可大幅降低产褥热死亡率，却遭同行抵制，是感染控制先驱。
events.summary_en: In 1847 Ignaz Semmelweis found that physicians’ handwashing could sharply reduce deaths from puerperal fever. Colleagues resisted him. He was a pioneer of infection control.

image.author: After Jenő Doby's engravig
image.caption: 塞麦尔维斯像（1860）

events.title: 辛普森引入氯仿麻醉
events.title_en: Simpson introduces chloroform anaesthesia
events.summary: 1847年11月爱丁堡产科教授詹姆斯·扬·辛普森自身试吸氯仿发现其麻醉作用，随即在皇家医院用于产科和外科，并出版《新麻醉剂说明》，推动分娩镇痛与吸入麻醉普及。
events.summary_en: In November 1847 Simpson discovered chloroform's anaesthetic action by self-experiment and introduced it into obstetric and surgical practice in Edinburgh.
works: Account of a New Anaesthetic Agent
works_en: Account of a New Anaesthetic Agent

events.title: 伊丽莎白·布莱克韦尔获医学学位
events.title_en: Elizabeth Blackwell receives a medical degree
events.summary: 1849年伊丽莎白·布莱克韦尔成为美国首位获医学学位的女性，推动女性进入医学职业。
events.summary_en: In 1849 Elizabeth Blackwell became the first woman to receive a medical degree in the United States, helping to open the medical profession to women.

events.title: 合信《全体新论》
events.title_en: Benjamin Hobson's Quanti xinlun
events.summary: 伦敦会医学传教士合信在广州与中国助手陈修堂等合作编译《全体新论》，咸丰元年（1851）成书，同年在上海刊行。这是第一部系统介绍西方解剖生理学的汉文书，冲击了以藏象学说为基础的传统身体观，日本后来也有翻刻本和日译本。
events.summary_en: Hobson's Quanti xinlun (1851), compiled in Canton with Chinese assistants and printed in Shanghai the same year, introduced Western anatomy and physiology to China and Japan and challenged the traditional zangxiang body concept.

events.title: 亥姆霍兹发明检眼镜
events.title_en: Helmholtz invents the ophthalmoscope
events.summary: 1851年德国物理学家、生理学家赫尔曼·冯·亥姆霍兹发表《检眼镜说明》，以烛光和玻片构成“眼镜”，首次在活体上观察视网膜与视神经，开创眼底检查，也成为后世各种内镜的原型。
events.summary_en: In 1851 Helmholtz published his "eye mirror", making the living retina visible for the first time; it became the model for later endoscopy.

events.title: 王孟英《温热经纬》
events.title_en: Wang Mengying, Warp and Weft of Warm-Heat Diseases
events.summary: 王士雄（孟英）1852年辑《温热经纬》，整理叶薛吴等温病学说，是晚清温病学重要选本。
events.summary_en: In 1852 Wang Shixiong (Mengying) compiled the Wenre Jingwei, arranging the warm-disease doctrines of Ye, Xue, Wu, and others. It is an important late-Qing anthology of warm-disease studies.
works_en: Wenre Jingwei (Warp and Weft of Warm-Heat Diseases)

events.title: 伍德与普拉瓦兹的皮下注射器
events.title_en: Wood and Pravaz hypodermic syringes
events.summary: 1853年苏格兰医生亚历山大·伍德与法国外科医生普拉瓦兹几乎同时各自发明皮下注射器；伍德用玻璃针筒在痛点皮下注射吗啡治疗神经痛，确立皮下给药方法。
events.summary_en: In 1853 Alexander Wood and Charles-Gabriel Pravaz independently devised hypodermic syringes; Wood injected morphine for neuralgia.
people: 夏尔-加布里埃尔·普拉瓦兹

events.title: 斯诺霍乱地图与水泵
events.title_en: Snow’s cholera map and the Broad Street pump
events.summary: 约翰·斯诺1854年通过伦敦宽街霍乱地图论证水源传播，成为流行病学经典案例。
events.summary_en: In 1854 John Snow used a map of cholera on Broad Street in London to argue for transmission by water. The case became a classic of epidemiology.

events.title: 艾迪生描述肾上腺功能不全
events.title_en: Addison describes adrenal insufficiency
events.summary: 1855年伦敦盖伊医院医生托马斯·艾迪生出版专著《肾上腺疾病的全身与局部效应》，首次描述以乏力、皮肤色素沉着为特征的肾上腺皮质衰竭，即艾迪生病，开内分泌疾病临床研究先河。
events.summary_en: Addison's 1855 monograph on disease of the suprarenal capsules gave the first description of adrenocortical failure (Addison's disease).
works: On the Constitutional and Local Effects of Disease of the Supra-renal Capsules
works_en: On the Constitutional and Local Effects of Disease of the Supra-renal Capsules

events.title: 魏尔啸细胞病理学
events.title_en: Virchow’s cellular pathology
events.summary: 鲁道夫·魏尔啸1858年前后确立细胞病理学，以细胞病变解释疾病，标志体液论的终结。
events.summary_en: Around 1858 Rudolf Virchow established cellular pathology, explaining disease by changes in cells and marking the end of humoral theory.

events.title: 南丁格尔护理学校
events.title_en: The Nightingale nursing school
events.summary: 弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔克里米亚战争后推动医院卫生改革，1860年在圣托马斯医院创办护理学校，奠基现代护理。
events.summary_en: After the Crimean War, Florence Nightingale pushed hospital sanitary reform. In 1860 she founded a nursing school at St Thomas’ Hospital and laid the foundation of modern nursing.

events.title: 巴斯德微生物致病研究
events.title_en: Pasteur’s research on microbial causes of disease
events.summary: 路易·巴斯德1860年代以发酵与灭菌实验支持微生物致病，否定自然发生说，奠定微生物学与灭菌术基础。
events.summary_en: In the 1860s Louis Pasteur’s experiments on fermentation and sterilization supported the idea that microorganisms cause disease, rejected spontaneous generation, and laid the foundation of microbiology and sterilization.

events.title: 布罗卡定位语言区
events.title_en: Broca localizes speech to the left frontal lobe
events.summary: 1861年法国外科医生布罗卡解剖仅能说“tan”的失语患者勒博尔涅之脑，发现左额叶病变，宣布左额叶为言语产生之所，确立大脑功能定位，该区后称布罗卡区。
events.summary_en: In 1861 Broca, after autopsy of the aphasic patient "Tan", announced the left frontal lobe as the seat of articulate speech (Broca's area).
works: Remarques sur le siège de la faculté du langage articulé
works_en: Remarques sur le siège de la faculté du langage articulé

events.title: 红十字国际委员会成立与《日内瓦公约》
events.title_en: ICRC founded and first Geneva Convention
events.summary: 受杜南《索尔费里诺回忆》推动，1863年红十字国际委员会在日内瓦成立；1864年首部《日内瓦公约》通过，规定战场伤病员一律救护、医护人员以白底红十字标志受保护。杜南获1901年首届诺贝尔和平奖。
events.summary_en: The ICRC was founded in 1863 on Dunant's initiative; the 1864 Geneva Convention protected wounded soldiers and red-cross-marked medical staff.

events.title: 吴师机《理瀹骈文》
events.title_en: Wu Shiji's Liyue pianwen
events.summary: 清代吴师机以骈文写成外治专书，系统论述膏药、敷贴、熏洗等外治法，提出“外治之理即内治之理”。
events.summary_en: Wu Shiji of the Qing dynasty wrote a book on external treatment in parallel prose. It sets out plasters, poultices, fumigation and washes, holding that external and internal treatment follow the same principles.

events.title: 贝尔纳实验生理学与内环境
events.title_en: Bernard’s experimental physiology and the internal environment
events.summary: 克洛德·贝尔纳提出内环境稳定等概念，确立现代实验生理学方法。
events.summary_en: Claude Bernard proposed concepts such as the stability of the internal environment and established the methods of modern experimental physiology.
works: Introduction to the Study of Experimental Medicine
works_en: Introduction to the Study of Experimental Medicine

events.title: 加勒特·安德森成为英国首位女医师
events.title_en: Elizabeth Garrett Anderson qualifies in Britain
events.summary: 被医学院拒收后自学的伊丽莎白·加勒特·安德森，于1865年9月28日取得药剂师协会执照，成为在英国本土取得医师资格并登记注册的第一位女性，后参与创办伦敦女子医学院。
events.summary_en: On 28 September 1865 Garrett Anderson became a Licentiate of the Society of Apothecaries, the first woman to qualify in medicine in Britain.
people: 伊丽莎白·加勒特·安德森

events.title: 嘉约翰在博济医院创办医学堂
events.title_en: John G. Kerr founds the medical school at the Canton Hospital
events.summary: 美国长老会医学传教士嘉约翰于1858年在广州重建博济医院，1866年在院内设立博济医学堂，这是西方人在中国开办的第一所医学校，孙中山后来也在这里学过医。1886年中国博医会成立，嘉约翰当选首任会长。
events.summary_en: John Glasgow Kerr re-founded the Canton Hospital in 1858 and in 1866 opened the first Western-run medical school in China there. In 1886 he became the first president of the China Medical Missionary Association.

events.title: 孟德尔豌豆杂交遗传定律
events.title_en: Mendel's laws of inheritance
events.summary: 奥古斯丁会修士孟德尔以八年豌豆杂交实验为据，1865年在布尔诺自然科学学会宣读、1866年发表《植物杂交实验》，否定融合遗传并提出分离与自由组合规律，1900年被重新发现后成为遗传学基础。
events.summary_en: Mendel's "Versuche über Pflanzen-Hybriden" (read 1865, published 1866) discredited blending inheritance and proposed laws of inheritance.

events.title: 李斯特抗菌外科原则
events.title_en: Lister’s antiseptic principle of surgery
events.summary: 约瑟夫·李斯特1867年发表抗菌外科原则，用石炭酸消毒，显著降低术后感染，开创无菌外科时代。
events.summary_en: In 1867 Joseph Lister published the antiseptic principle of surgery, using carbolic acid for disinfection. Postoperative infection fell sharply, and the era of antiseptic surgery began.
works: Antiseptic Principle of the Practice of Surgery
works_en: Antiseptic Principle of the Practice of Surgery

events.title: 科赫与巴斯德确立细菌学说
events.title_en: Koch and Pasteur establish the germ theory
events.summary: 约1870年代罗伯特·科赫与巴斯德共同确立细菌致病学说；科赫后来提出科赫法则并发现结核杆菌等。
events.summary_en: In the 1870s Robert Koch and Pasteur together established the doctrine that bacteria cause disease. Koch later stated Koch’s postulates and discovered the tubercle bacillus, among other organisms.

events.title: 高尔基“黑色反应”染色法
events.title_en: Golgi's "black reaction" stain
events.summary: 1873年意大利病理学家卡米洛·高尔基首次简报以硝酸银为基础的“黑色反应”，可使个别神经细胞全貌显现；他据此支持网状学说，1906年与卡哈尔共获诺贝尔奖。
events.summary_en: Golgi first documented the silver-based "black reaction" in 1873, revealing whole nerve cells; he shared the 1906 Nobel Prize with Cajal.

events.title: 早期霍乱疫苗
events.title_en: Early cholera vaccines
events.summary: 约1879年出现早期霍乱疫苗尝试，反映细菌学时代疫苗研发的迅速扩展（后续剂型不断改进）。
events.summary_en: About 1879 early attempts at a cholera vaccine appeared, reflecting the rapid spread of vaccine development in the bacteriological era. Later preparations continued to be improved.

events.title: 拉韦朗发现疟原虫
events.title_en: Laveran discovers the malaria parasite
events.summary: 1880年法国军医拉韦朗在阿尔及利亚君士坦丁军医院检查疟疾患者血液，发现红细胞内的原虫（后称疟原虫），首次证明原生动物可致病，1907年获诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
events.summary_en: In 1880 at Constantine, Algeria, army physician Laveran found a protozoan parasite in malaria patients' blood; Nobel Prize 1907.

events.title: 巴斯德炭疽减毒疫苗
events.title_en: Pasteur’s attenuated anthrax vaccine
events.summary: 1881年巴斯德公开演示炭疽减毒疫苗，证明可用减弱病原诱导免疫，推动疫苗学。
events.summary_en: In 1881 Pasteur publicly demonstrated an attenuated anthrax vaccine, showing that a weakened pathogen could induce immunity and advancing vaccinology.

events.title: 马根济在李鸿章资助下创办天津医学馆
events.title_en: John K. Mackenzie founds the Tianjin medical school with Li Hongzhang's support
events.summary: 伦敦会传教医生马根济1879年移居天津，在李鸿章资助下建立伦敦会医院，1881年开办医学馆，为北洋海陆军培养西医。不过陆海军不愿任用外国人培养的医生，这次办学成效有限。
events.summary_en: Mackenzie moved to Tianjin in 1879 and, with Li Hongzhang's patronage, built a hospital and in 1881 opened a medical school, which had limited success because the armed forces were reluctant to employ foreign-trained doctors.

events.title: 比尔罗特首例成功胃切除
events.title_en: Billroth's first successful gastrectomy
events.summary: 1881年1月29日维也纳大学外科教授比尔罗特为43岁胃癌女患者特蕾泽·黑勒成功施行幽门（远端胃）切除并胃十二指肠吻合（比尔罗特Ⅰ式），开启现代胃外科。
events.summary_en: On 29 January 1881 Billroth performed a successful distal gastrectomy with gastroduodenal anastomosis on Therese Heller, opening modern gastric surgery.

events.title: 科赫发现结核杆菌
events.title_en: Koch discovers the tubercle bacillus
events.summary: 罗伯特·科赫1882年分离结核分枝杆菌，并用严格实验证明其致病性，1905年获诺贝尔奖。
events.summary_en: In 1882 Robert Koch isolated Mycobacterium tuberculosis and proved its pathogenicity with strict experiments. He received the Nobel Prize in 1905.

image.author: Wilhelm Fechner
image.caption: 科赫像（约 1900）
image.caption_en: Robert Koch. Fotogravur nach einer Fotografie von Wilhelm Fechner, um 1900.[1]

events.title: 唐容川中西汇通
events.title_en: Tang Rongchuan and the convergence of Chinese and Western medicine
events.summary: 唐宗海（容川）1884年著《中西汇通医书五种》，尝试会通中西医学，开启近代中西医汇通思潮。
events.summary_en: In 1884 Tang Zonghai (Rongchuan) wrote Five Books on the Convergence of Chinese and Western Medicine. He tried to bring the two medicines into communication and opened the modern current of Chinese-Western convergence.
works_en: Five Books on the Convergence of Chinese and Western Medicine
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 科赫法则系统表述
events.title_en: Koch’s postulates are stated systematically
events.summary: 罗伯特·科赫在研究病原菌过程中形成后称“科赫法则”的验证步骤，成为传染病病因学标准。
events.summary_en: In the course of studying pathogenic bacteria, Robert Koch formed the verification steps later called Koch’s postulates. They became a standard of infectious-disease etiology.

events.title: 巴斯德狂犬病疫苗用于人体
events.title_en: Pasteur’s rabies vaccine is used in humans
events.summary: 1885年巴斯德团队将狂犬病疫苗用于人体，是詹纳之后重大的人类疫苗突破；1888年巴斯德研究所成立。
events.summary_en: In 1885 Pasteur’s team used a rabies vaccine in humans, a major human-vaccine advance after Jenner. The Pasteur Institute was founded in 1888.

events.title: 中国博医会成立
events.title_en: China Medical Missionary Association founded
events.summary: 1886年，在华欧美医学传教士成立中国博医会，这是中国出现的第一个近代医学团体。嘉约翰任首任会长，兼任《博医会报》首任主编。
events.summary_en: In 1886 missionary doctors founded the China Medical Missionary Association, the first modern medical association in China, with John Kerr as its first chairman and editor of its journal.

events.title: 香港华人西医书院创办与孙中山
events.title_en: Hong Kong College of Medicine for Chinese and Sun Yat-sen
events.summary: 1887年，香港华人西医书院创办，立意把西方科学和医学引入中国。康德黎当年夏天到港，任筹办委员会秘书。孙中山是首批学生之一，1892年毕业。连同孙中山，书院共培养59名毕业生，后来并入香港大学医学院。
events.summary_en: Founded in 1887 to bring Western medicine to China, the Hong Kong College of Medicine for Chinese counted Sun Yat-sen among its first students (graduated 1892) and fifty-nine other graduates. It later became part of HKU's medical faculty.

events.title: 巴斯德研究所成立
events.title_en: Founding of the Pasteur Institute
events.summary: 1888年巴黎巴斯德研究所开幕，成为全球生物医学研究机构的早期典范。
events.summary_en: The Pasteur Institute in Paris opened in 1888 and became an early model of a biomedical research institution.

events.title: 卡哈尔与神经元学说
events.title_en: Ramón y Cajal and the neuron doctrine
events.summary: 西班牙学者拉蒙-卡哈尔自1887年起改良运用高尔基染色法，证明每个神经细胞是独立单元，神经冲动经突触在细胞间传递，奠定神经元学说，与高尔基共获1906年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
events.summary_en: From 1887 Cajal used Golgi's method to show that each nerve cell is an independent unit, founding the neuron doctrine; Nobel Prize 1906.

events.title: 北里柴三郎纯培养破伤风杆菌
events.title_en: Kitasato's pure culture of tetanus bacillus
events.summary: 1889年在柏林科赫实验室工作的日本学者北里柴三郎首次获得破伤风杆菌纯培养，阐明其病理；次年与贝林合作发展血清疗法。
events.summary_en: In 1889 in Koch's Berlin laboratory, Kitasato first grew the tetanus bacillus in pure culture, paving the way for serum therapy with Behring.

events.title: 约翰斯·霍普金斯医院开业
events.title_en: Johns Hopkins Hospital opens
events.summary: 1889年5月7日巴尔的摩约翰斯·霍普金斯医院开业，是最早将诊疗、教学与研究结合的教学医院之一，开业时有17栋楼、330张床；四年后医学院成立，住院医师制度等由此推广。
events.summary_en: Opened 7 May 1889, Johns Hopkins Hospital was an early model teaching hospital uniting patient care, education and research.

events.title: 贝林抗毒素与白喉破伤风血清
events.title_en: Behring’s antitoxin and diphtheria and tetanus serum
events.summary: 埃米尔·冯·贝林1890年发现抗毒素并用于白喉与破伤风，开创血清疗法，1901年获首届诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
events.summary_en: In 1890 Emil von Behring discovered antitoxin and used it for diphtheria and tetanus, opening serum therapy. In 1901 he received the first Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.

events.title: 霍尔斯特德外科原则
events.title_en: Halsted’s surgical principles
events.summary: 威廉·霍尔斯特德在约翰斯·霍普金斯推行严格消毒、轻柔操作与住院医师制度，塑造现代外科训练。
events.summary_en: William Halsted at Johns Hopkins promoted strict asepsis, gentle technique, and the residency system, shaping modern surgical training.

events.title: 伊万诺夫斯基与拜耶林克发现病毒
events.title_en: Ivanovsky and Beijerinck discover filterable virus
events.summary: 1892年伊万诺夫斯基发现烟草花叶病病原能通过细菌滤器；1898年拜耶林克证明其可连续传代并扩散于琼脂，提出“有传染性的活液”并称之为病毒，标志病毒学诞生。
events.summary_en: Ivanovsky (1892) showed tobacco mosaic agent passes bacterial filters; Beijerinck (1898) called it a "contagium vivum fluidum" — a virus.
people: 德米特里·伊万诺夫斯基

events.title: 耶尔森在香港发现鼠疫杆菌
events.title_en: Yersin identifies the plague bacillus in Hong Kong
events.summary: 1894年香港鼠疫流行期间，巴斯德学派的耶尔森在简陋草棚实验室中分离出鼠疫杆菌，结果发表于同年9月《巴斯德研究所年鉴》；北里柴三郎几乎同时独立分离该菌，后命名为耶尔森菌。
events.summary_en: During the 1894 Hong Kong epidemic Yersin isolated the plague bacterium (now Yersinia pestis); Kitasato isolated it independently at nearly the same time.

events.title: 伦琴发现X射线
events.title_en: Röntgen discovers X-rays
events.summary: 威廉·伦琴1895年发现X射线并迅速用于医学成像，开创放射诊断学。
events.summary_en: In 1895 Wilhelm Röntgen discovered X-rays, which were quickly used for medical imaging and opened diagnostic radiology.

image.author: Wilhelm Röntgen
image.caption: 伦琴为妻子拍摄的手部 X 光片（1895）
image.caption_en: Hand mit Ringen (Hand with Rings): a print of one of the first X-rays by Wilhelm Röntgen (1845–1923) of the left hand of his wife Anna Berth

events.title: 里瓦-罗奇血压计
events.title_en: The Riva-Rocci sphygmomanometer
events.summary: 希皮奥内·里瓦-罗奇1896年发明袖带血压计，使无创血压测量进入临床常规。
events.summary_en: In 1896 Scipione Riva-Rocci invented the cuff sphygmomanometer, bringing noninvasive blood-pressure measurement into routine clinical use.

events.title: 罗斯证明蚊传疟疾
events.title_en: Ross shows mosquitoes transmit malaria
events.summary: 英印军医罗纳德·罗斯在印度以按蚊叮咬患者后解剖观察，1897年在蚊胃中发现疟原虫，进而阐明疟原虫在蚊体内的生活史，证实拉韦朗与曼森的蚊媒假说，1902年获诺贝尔奖。
events.summary_en: In 1897 Ross found malaria parasites in the Anopheles mosquito gut and demonstrated their life cycle, confirming the Laveran–Manson hypothesis; Nobel 1902.

events.title: 拜耳推出阿司匹林
events.title_en: Bayer introduces aspirin
events.summary: 1899年拜耳公司推出阿司匹林（乙酰水杨酸）；水杨酸类镇痛解热传统可追溯至希波克拉底时代的柳树应用。
events.summary_en: In 1899 Bayer introduced aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid). The analgesic and antipyretic tradition of salicylates can be traced to the Hippocratic use of willow.

events.foundSite: 敦煌莫高窟藏经洞（第17窟，位于第16窟甬道北壁）
events.repository: 分藏于中国国家图书馆、大英图书馆、法国国家图书馆等
events.repository_en: Held by the National Library of China, the British Library, the Bibliothèque nationale de France and others
events.title: 敦煌藏经洞发现（含医药卷子）
events.title_en: Discovery of the Dunhuang Library Cave
events.summary: 1900年，道士王圆箓在清理第16窟时发现了藏经洞密室。洞中出土的写本里有二百多件中医药文书，年代约在一千年前或稍晚，内容包括《灸经图》等，是研究唐五代医学的重要一手材料。
events.summary_en: In 1900 the Daoist Wang Yuanlu found the sealed Library Cave while clearing Cave 16 at Mogao. Among the manuscripts are over two hundred medical texts from about a thousand years ago, including moxibustion charts, key primary sources for Tang and Five Dynasties medicine.

events.title: 阿尔茨海默描述病例
events.title_en: Alzheimer describes a case
events.summary: 阿洛伊斯·阿尔茨海默1901年识别后来称为阿尔茨海默病的病例，开创神经退行性疾病临床病理研究。
events.summary_en: In 1901 Alois Alzheimer identified the case later called Alzheimer’s disease, opening clinical and pathological study of neurodegenerative disease.

events.title: 兰德施泰纳发现血型
events.title_en: Landsteiner discovers blood groups
events.summary: 卡尔·兰德施泰纳1901年发现ABO血型，使安全输血成为可能，1930年获诺贝尔奖。
events.summary_en: In 1901 Karl Landsteiner discovered the ABO blood groups, making safer transfusion possible. He received the Nobel Prize in 1930.

events.title: 库欣开创现代神经外科
events.title_en: Harvey Cushing founds modern neurosurgery
events.summary: 美国外科医生哈维·库欣把神经外科建成独立专科,在脑肿瘤诊治和垂体疾病研究上作出系统贡献,并描述了“库欣病”。他被誉为“现代神经外科之父”,美国神经外科医师协会的标志用的就是他的肖像。
events.summary_en: Harvey Cushing established neurosurgery as a distinct specialty, advanced brain-tumour surgery and pituitary research, and is regarded as the father of modern neurological surgery.

events.title: 卡雷尔血管缝合术
events.title_en: Carrel’s vascular suture
events.summary: 亚历克西斯·卡雷尔发展血管吻合技术，为器官移植与血管外科奠基，1912年获诺贝尔奖。
events.summary_en: Alexis Carrel developed techniques of vascular anastomosis, a foundation of organ transplantation and vascular surgery. He received the Nobel Prize in 1912.

events.title: 艾因托芬心电图
events.title_en: Einthoven’s electrocardiogram
events.summary: 威廉·艾因托芬约1903年完善弦线电流计心电图，使心脏电活动可记录，奠定临床心电学（常记为1903年实用化）。
events.summary_en: About 1903 Willem Einthoven refined the string-galvanometer electrocardiogram so that the heart’s electrical activity could be recorded, establishing clinical electrocardiography. The practical form is often dated to 1903.

events.title: 霍普金斯提出维生素概念
events.title_en: Frederick Hopkins proposes the vitamin concept
events.summary: 弗雷德里克·霍普金斯1906年提出食物中存在必需微量因子（维生素），解释坏血病、佝偻病等缺乏病。
events.summary_en: In 1906 Frederick Hopkins proposed that foods contain essential trace factors (vitamins), explaining deficiency diseases such as scurvy and rickets.

events.repository: 中国国家图书馆、大英图书馆、法国国家图书馆等
events.repository_en: National Library of China, British Library, Bibliothèque nationale de France and others
events.title: 敦煌写卷流散海外
events.title_en: Dispersal of Dunhuang manuscripts
events.summary: 1907年斯坦因购走29箱写卷和绘画，成为今天英国藏品的主体；1908年伯希和在藏经洞挑选了上千卷。1909年清学部把剩余的八千余件运往北京，现为中国国家图书馆的主要藏品。日本大谷探险队（1911）和俄国奥登堡（1914）也各有所得，敦煌医药卷子因此分藏世界各地。
events.summary_en: Stein bought 29 cases of manuscripts and paintings in 1907, forming the core of the British holdings; Pelliot selected thousands in 1908; the remaining 8,000+ went to Beijing in 1909. Otani (1911) and Oldenburg (1914) also acquired items, so Dunhuang medical manuscripts are now dispersed worldwide.

events.title: 首部汉译日本产科专著《竹氏产婆学》
events.title_en: First Chinese translation of a Japanese obstetrics monograph
events.summary: 清末取道日本引进西医的风气兴起。1908年，日本竹中成宪的《竹氏产婆学》译成中文出版，是近代中国第一部翻译的日本产科专著，代表了清末民初大规模译介日本医书的潮流。
events.summary_en: In 1908 Takenaka Seiken's Zhu Shi Chan Po Xue became the first Japanese obstetrics monograph translated into Chinese, part of the late-Qing wave of medical translation via Japan.

events.title: 张锡纯《医学衷中参西录》
events.title_en: Zhang Xichun, Records of Chinese Medicine with Reference to Western Medicine
events.summary: 张锡纯1909年起刊《医学衷中参西录》，以中医为本参用西药西理，是近代中西汇通代表作。
events.summary_en: From 1909 Zhang Xichun published the Yixue Zhongzhong Canxi Lu. Taking Chinese medicine as the basis and drawing on Western drugs and reasoning, it is a representative modern work of Chinese-Western convergence.
works_en: Yixue Zhongzhong Canxi Lu (Records of Chinese Medicine with Reference to Western Medicine)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 埃利希化学疗法（洒尔佛散）
events.title_en: Ehrlich’s chemotherapy (Salvarsan)
events.summary: 保罗·埃利希约1909年研制砷化合物洒尔佛散治疗梅毒，提出“魔弹”概念，开创抗微生物化疗。
events.summary_en: About 1909 Paul Ehrlich developed the arsenic compound Salvarsan for syphilis and proposed the “magic bullet,” opening antimicrobial chemotherapy.

events.title: 洒尔佛散治疗梅毒上市
events.title_en: Salvarsan for syphilis comes into use
events.summary: 埃利希与秦佐八郎研制的砷剂洒尔佛散（606）约1910年用于梅毒，标志化疗药物时代。
events.summary_en: The arsenic preparation Salvarsan (606), developed by Ehrlich and Sahachiro Hata, was used for syphilis about 1910 and marks the era of chemotherapeutic drugs.

events.title: 弗莱克斯纳报告改革北美医学教育
events.title_en: The Flexner Report reforms North American medical education
events.summary: 亚伯拉罕·弗莱克斯纳1910年报告促使北美关闭不合格医校，确立大学—实验室—医院三位一体的现代医学教育模式。
events.summary_en: Abraham Flexner’s 1910 report led to the closure of substandard medical schools in North America and established the modern model of medical education joining university, laboratory, and hospital.

events.title: 伍连德主持东北肺鼠疫防控
events.title_en: Wu Lien-teh leads the Manchurian pneumonic plague response
events.summary: 1910—1911年东北肺鼠疫流行，伍连德通过尸体解剖确认飞沫传播，推行隔离、口罩和遗体火化，1911年在奉天主持万国鼠疫研究会。
events.summary_en: During the 1910–1911 pneumonic plague in Manchuria, Wu Lien-teh confirmed airborne spread by autopsy and introduced isolation, masks and cremation. In 1911 he chaired the International Plague Conference in Mukden.

image.caption: 东北鼠疫防疫传单（1910—1911）
image.caption_en: Manchurian Plague of 1910-1911. Photographs are Glass Lantern Slides taken from the papers of Dr. Richard Pearson Strong, on repository at H

events.title: 张仲元：清太医院最后一任院使
events.title_en: Zhang Zhongyuan, last head of the Qing Imperial Academy of Medicine
events.summary: 张仲元从太医院最低品级的医官做起，一直升到院使，是清朝太医院最后一任主管。他曾为慈禧太后和光绪帝诊治，也主张改革太医院。研究者据清宫医案等资料复原了他的生平。
events.summary_en: Zhang Zhongyuan rose from the lowest rank to become the last chief of the Qing Imperial Academy of Medicine. He treated Cixi and Guangxu and advocated reforms of the Academy.

events.title: 民国天津的中医学校教育
events.title_en: Modern TCM education in Republican Tianjin
events.summary: 清末民初，学校教育逐渐成为医学教育的主流。天津原本已有北洋医学堂、陆军军医学校等西医院校，却没有一所中医学校。民国时期天津中医界陆续办起中医学校教育，反映出中医在中西医竞争中通过学校化求生存的努力。
events.summary_en: By the late Qing, school-based education had become the mainstream. Tianjin had Western schools such as the Peiyang Medical College but no TCM school until Republican-era efforts created one.

events.title: 张骥与《汲古医学丛书》
events.title_en: Zhang Ji and the Jigu yixue congshu
events.summary: 张骥是民国时期四川著名的医学家、医史学家和医学教育家。他的《汲古医学丛书》汇集了他校辑古医籍和医学研究的成果，是民国地方中医整理古籍、办教育的代表。
events.summary_en: Zhang Ji was a Sichuan medical scholar, historian and educator of the Republican era. His Jigu yixue congshu collects his work on ancient medical texts.

events.title: 中华医学会成立
events.title_en: Founding of the Chinese Medical Association
events.summary: 1915年中华医学会成立并创刊《中华医学杂志》，主要推动现代西医学在中国的职业化（与中医界并行）。
events.summary_en: In 1915 the Chinese Medical Association was founded and launched the National Medical Journal of China. It mainly advanced the professionalization of modern Western medicine in China, alongside the Chinese-medicine community.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 上海中医专门学校开学
events.title_en: The Shanghai Specialized School of Chinese Medicine opens
events.summary: 1917年上海中医专门学校开学，代表近代中医学校教育对传统师承的补充。
events.summary_en: In 1917 the Shanghai Specialized School of Chinese Medicine opened, representing a modern school education in Chinese medicine that supplemented traditional apprenticeship.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 噬菌体发现
events.title_en: Discovery of bacteriophage
events.summary: 约1915–1917年特沃特与德埃雷尔发现噬菌体，后成为分子遗传与替代抗菌研究的重要对象。
events.summary_en: About 1915–1917 Frederick Twort and Félix d’Hérelle discovered bacteriophage, which later became an important object of molecular genetics and of research on alternatives to antibacterials.

events.title: 洛克菲勒基金会创办北京协和医学院
events.title_en: Rockefeller Foundation establishes Peking Union Medical College
events.summary: 1917年，洛克菲勒基金会在原协和医学堂（1906年由教会联合创办）的基础上正式建立北京协和医学院。1919年起，学院实行八年制医学本科教育，是中国最早的八年制临床医学教育，深刻影响了近代中国西医教育和科研体系。
events.summary_en: The Rockefeller Foundation formally established PUMC in 1917, building on the 1906 Union Medical College. From 1919 it ran China's first eight-year medical programme.

events.title: 1918年流感大流行
events.title_en: 1918 influenza pandemic
events.summary: 1918–1919年,H1N1甲型流感在全球大流行,估计至少造成5000万人死亡,其中美国约67.5万人。5岁以下、20–40岁和65岁以上人群死亡率都很高。这次大流行深刻影响了此后的公共卫生监测体系和流感病毒学研究。
events.summary_en: The 1918–1919 H1N1 pandemic killed an estimated 50 million people worldwide, about 675,000 of them in the US, with high mortality among children under 5, adults aged 20–40 and those over 65.

events.title: 班廷与贝斯特发现胰岛素
events.title_en: Banting and Best discover insulin
events.summary: 弗雷德里克·班廷与查尔斯·贝斯特1921年分离胰岛素，使1型糖尿病从绝症变为可治，1923年班廷获诺贝尔奖。
events.summary_en: In 1921 Frederick Banting and Charles Best isolated insulin, turning type 1 diabetes from a fatal disease into a treatable one. Banting received the Nobel Prize in 1923.
